summary.text: Titan goddess of divine order and custom, daughter of Gaia and Uranus and mother by Zeus of the Seasons and the three Fates.

story.text: Gaia bore Themis to starry Uranus among the elder Titan gods, sister to Oceanus, Cronus, Rhea and their great brood.

After Metis, Zeus married bright Themis. She bore the Horae — Eunomia, Dike and blooming Eirene — who watch over the works of mortals, and the Moirai, Clotho, Lachesis and Atropos, to whom Zeus gave the greatest honor.
Apollodorus likewise numbers Themis among the Titan daughters of Earth and Sky and makes her the mother by Zeus of the Seasons and the Fates.
